## Ingredients
- chicken (raw; grillable from raw)
- bun bot (ready to use)
- bun top (ready to use)

## Available Actions
- **grill** `<item>`  —  Grill an item on the grill. Takes 10 seconds. Produces a grilled item.
- **stack** `<item>`  —  Place an ingredient on top of the current stack. Takes 1 second. The item must already be in its required state before stacking.

## Station Constraints
- **grill**: capacity 1 (at most 1 grill action running at once)

## Goal
The following ingredients must be prepared:
- chicken must be grilled

Assemble the final dish by stacking the ingredients in this order (bottom to top):
  1. bun bot
  2. grilled chicken
  3. bun top
domain_pddl:
(define (domain cooking)
  (:requirements :durative-actions :typing)
  (:types item)
  (:constants
    chicken bun_bot bun_top - item
  )

  (:predicates
    (raw ?i - item)
    (grilled ?i - item)
    (stackable ?i - item)
    (stacked ?i - item)
    (grill_free)
  )
  (:durative-action grill
    :parameters (?i - item)
    :duration (= ?duration 10)
    :condition (and
      (at start (raw ?i))
      (at start (grill_free))
    )
    :effect (and
      (at start (not (raw ?i)))
      (at start (not (grill_free)))
      (at end (grilled ?i))
      (at end (stackable ?i))
      (at end (grill_free))
    )
  )
  (:durative-action stack_bun_bot
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 1)
    :condition (at start (stackable bun_bot))
    :effect (and
      (at start (not (stackable bun_bot)))
      (at end (stacked bun_bot))
    )
  )
  (:durative-action stack_chicken
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 1)
    :condition (and
      (at start (stackable chicken))
      (at start (stacked bun_bot))
    )
    :effect (and
      (at start (not (stackable chicken)))
      (at end (stacked chicken))
    )
  )
  (:durative-action stack_bun_top
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 1)
    :condition (and
      (at start (stackable bun_top))
      (at start (stacked chicken))
    )
    :effect (and
      (at start (not (stackable bun_top)))
      (at end (stacked bun_top))
    )
  )
)
problem_pddl:
(define (problem grill_chicken_sandwich)
  (:domain cooking)
  (:objects
    chicken bun_bot bun_top - item
  )
  (:init
    (raw chicken)
    (stackable bun_bot)
    (stackable bun_top)
    (grill_free)
  )
  (:goal (and
